snippet.title: Dough Slapping: A Touch to Desire Teaser
snippet.description:
Enter the quirky world of Dough Slapping: A Touch to Desire, where you slap dough with your left or right hand. Join Mark's journey filled with humor, heartfelt monologues, and unexpected revelations as you master the art of the perfect slap in this unique and comedic simulator.

Available on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346940/Dough_Slapping_A_Touch_to_Desire/
